Our Story

Chapter One · Two Shores

He comes from Kherson, where the Dnipro runs wide and unhurried. She comes from Tavda, a small town beyond the Urals, where the winters are long and the forests endless. Two hometowns, two worlds, thousands of kilometres apart — and not a single reason to ever meet.

And then, Canada. A new country, a new language, a whole new life — for both of us. Somewhere in the middle of all that beginning again, we found each other.

Chapter Two · Just Friends

For about a year, we were just friends. Good friends — the kind who laugh too loudly, talk too long, and always find one more reason to stay a little longer. Neither of us was in a hurry. Love, apparently, was in no hurry either — it was simply waiting for the right evening.

Chapter Three · The Birthday

Then came Anastasiia's birthday. Somewhere between the candles and the celebration, we both realized — in the very same moment — that this wasn't friendship anymore. We slipped away from everyone, climbed up to the rooftop of a parking garage — and stayed there, high above the lights of Toronto, talking until the city below us went quiet. Some evenings change everything. That was one of them.

“Above the city lights, everything changed.”

Chapter Four · She Said Yes

On October 11, 2026, in Montreal — a city that seems to have been made for romance — Mykhailo asked the most important question of his life. Anastasiia said yes.

The Proposal — Montreal, October 11, 2026

In August 2027, among the vineyards of Niagara, we begin our next chapter — and the view will be even better than from that rooftop. This time, we want you there to see it.
